author: PostOakLabs
description: One bond, declared once, measured three ways: modified duration (art-329), DV01 by central-difference full reprice (art-330), and convexity (art-331), with a combined price-move estimate for a declared yield shock showing duration only, duration plus convexity, and full reprice side by side. Middle office, not lifecycle-bound (risk measurement). Bullet bonds on an even-period schedule only; no odd first coupon, no stub period, parallel shifts only, no embedded options.

yield_shock_bp.description: Declared yield shock in basis points for the combined view

ytm_pct.description: Yield to maturity, percent per year
